name: A Man About a Murloc

angles.text: As an Alliance traveler, you may find murlocs troubling settlements along lakeshores and docks. Their incursions strain residents and guards across Elwynn and nearby Alliance territories.

aliases: who gives a man about a murloc
who starts a man about a murloc
faq.answer: Jason, a local fisherman, asks how to stop murlocs from raiding his catches.
faq.q: Who gives the quest A Man About a Murloc?

faq.answer: Remy "Two Times" is a local resident who has repeatedly warned the guards about murlocs. Jason hopes Remy can find a way to drive them away.
Murlocs raid Jason's catches, so he turns to Remy for help protecting his fishing.
faq.q: Why does Jason want to consult Remy?

faq.answer: Remy says the town guards ignore his warnings. He plans to strike back at the murlocs and asks you to gather materials.
faq.q: What does Remy plan to do about the murlocs?

faq.answer: Remy says he has repeatedly warned the local guards about the murlocs, but they have not heeded him.
faq.q: Why haven't the guards dealt with the murlocs?

aliases: where does a man about a murloc lead
after a man about a murloc
faq.answer: After you speak with Remy, he shares his plans to strike back at the local murlocs and sets you to further work for him.
faq.q: What happens after speaking to Remy?

sections.body: Jason is a local fisherman, and murlocs keep raiding his catches. He knows Remy "Two Times" hates them as much as he does. So Jason sends you to ask whether Remy has found a way to drive the creatures from the waters.
sections.title: Trouble on the Water

sections.body: Remy says the local guards have ignored his repeated warnings about the murloc threat. He will not wait for their help. Instead, he prepares to strike back and asks you to aid his plans.
sections.title: Remy's Retaliation

summary: Jason's fishing is in danger, and he turns to Remy "Two Times" for help. Remy shares his hatred of murlocs and has plans of his own.
attribution: In-game quest text: A Man About a Murloc
